tpl: Selects the Operator with the highest Max HP within range, dealing {0} ATK as Arts damage and 30% of that Arts damage as Burn to all enemies surrounding that Operator every second for 20s

Attack Range changes, Attack Interval increases, ATK +{0}, and attacks 3 enemies at once; when attacking, loses 5% HP and sets a burning field at the location of the target: passing enemies have -50% Movement Speed and take 35% of Blaze the Igniting Spark's ATK as Arts damage and 30% of that Arts damage as Burn every second

Attack Range changes, ATK +{0}, Attack Interval greatly reduces, and normal attacks now deal AoE damage; if target is under the burst effect of Burn, deals an additional {1} ATK as Elemental Damage Loses 3% of Max HP every second; skill activation grants {2} ammo, and whenever an enemy enters the burst effect of Burn, gains 2 additional ammo; skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)
